notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
We're excited to roll out our next patch, featuring V-Sync, new graphics settings, and improved UX elements. Here's what’s new in this build:

1️⃣No PCs in outer space 
We've added V-Sync, a frame limiter, and resolution settings to help reduce CPU load and overheating. While some issues remain, we're actively working on a full fix.
2️⃣What's up with this wreath? 
We've introduced more hints to guide you smoothly toward the game's finale.
3️⃣What did I miss? 
Probably the puzzle clues! We've added extra guidelines to help with in-game puzzles.


⏳ Update schedule change 
Future patches won’t be as frequent as the last two, as we're temporarily freezing work on Chapter 1 to focus on Chapter 2. Stay tuned on Discord for sneak peeks, screenshots, and developer insights! Please wishlist our game on our main page!

Thanks for your support, and happy gaming!
